messages:
Nina Patel: Quick sync 11: we're piloting a concierge SI onboarding track next quarter for 3 strategic partners. Objective: shrink time-to-first-listing from 6 weeks to 2. Key components: personalized sandbox org, HW validation run, and a joint-launch checklist. Thoughts?
Diego Alvarez: Love that. Can we provide a pre-packaged infra repo so partners don't waste time wiring infra? Include terraform + sample model image + CI steps.
Sophie Tran: Yes. Also recommend a short "day-in-the-life" runbook for partner AMs: who to ping for sandbox resets, billing anomalies, and hardware failures. Keeps handoffs clean.
Nina Patel: Good call. Diego/Sophie, can you pair on an infra repo template? Target: 1 repo per cloud + 1 for private on-prem.
Omar El-Sayed: For the hardware validation, propose a two-step: 1) health & compatibility smoke (drivers, nv_peer_mem, firmware), 2) perf baseline (latency p50/p99 and throughput) using a small benchmark suite. We'll publish expected baselines per GPU class.
Diego Alvarez: I can mock the benchmark harness. Suggest we include scripts to collect Console traces and a minimal perf dashboard snapshot so partners can see regressions.
Sophie Tran: Certification mechanics: concierge track = handshake validation (we run the validation with partner engineer), pass/fail + a short readout session. Badge issued after a joint announcement readiness checklist is signed. Renewal every 9 months.
Nina Patel: Marketing ask: we want a co-marketing one-pager and a templated joint announcement email. Also, partners prefer a short customer-ready case study template to fill after first engagement.
onboard-helper-bot: Reminder: "Concierge SI Onboarding - planning meeting" scheduled May 4 09:30 PT.
Omar El-Sayed: Logistics: hardware loans need LOA + shipping window. I'll draft a vendor SLA template. Also need a secure key exchange plan for KMS materials during the validation run.
Diego Alvarez: Action items:
- Diego & Sophie: infra repo templates (cloud + private) + runbook drafts
- Omar: benchmark harness + vendor SLA draft
- Nina: co-marketing assets + case study template + schedule concierge cohort
Nina Patel: Thanks team. Let's aim to have repo skeletons and the benchmark harness ready for a dry-run two weeks before the cohort. Ping me when PRs are ready. :sparkles:
